name: HERMES_GRAFT_BASELINE_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: HERMES_GRAFT_BASELINE_20261107 — LQ-20261107-213. The self-tune persistence gate counted any
OUTCOME_LEDGER|eligible=1 day, whatever weights the outcome writer had compared against. Releases served
different weight files (the v9 git seed, a carried v19), so eligible days were mostly artifacts of a weak
baseline; weekend reruns on unchanged inputs counted as extra days; and the tuner grafted suggestions
computed against one baseline onto another. Each calibration row now carries weights=<fingerprint> and
inputs=<fingerprint>; the gate, the graft and the governor clamp-pressure check read only rows measured
against the live weights, counting a day only when its input set is new.
Registered because a new pytest file that no gate names is not run by CI (check_test_coverage --fail-on-new).
